I specifically booked an appointment with Dr. Patel, but my experience was very disappointing. She left during my consultation to attend someone else and, after returning, spent barely five minutes assessing my skin before immediately promoting expensive treatments and packages.

The consultation felt more like a sales pitch than a medical appointment. There was little effort to understand my skincare routine, products, concerns, or lifestyle. Instead, I was repeatedly encouraged to sign up for treatment programs. To make matters worse, she took a phone call during the consultation and seemed dismissive when discussing my previous treatment history.

Dear Preet, thank you for sharing your feedback.

We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet your expectations. We value your feedback and will use it to further improve our patient experience. Should you wish to discuss your concerns further, we would be happy to connect with you directly.

Warm regards,
The Bombay Skin Clinic

Team The Bombay Skin Clinic

featured_reviews.name: Jaya Gangwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to warn others about the appalling experience I had with Dr. Meeth’s clinic and their receptionist. I was 15 minutes late to my appointment (Had informed about it way in advance), but instead of showing some flexibility, the doctor walked out without even waiting when I was right outside the clinic. After 1.5 hours of travel and multiple requests to accommodate me, I was told he has left.

The receptionist was equally unhelpful and rude. Instead of informing the doctor that I had arrived or offering some understanding, they simply shrugged and said "the doctor had left, you'll have to reschedule." No empathy , just a complete lack of service.

The whole experience was dehumanizing and left me feeling frustrated and disrespected. I expect better from healthcare professionals.

In response to this one can either defend themselves or mend their ways and create a more pleasant experience for their patients. Never had such an unresponsive experience before with any healthcare service.

Rating: 1/5 stars

featured_reviews.name: Indu Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
I loved the experience and results I have had from Joven Clinic. I had come to Dr. Meet with a severe acne issue, and he guided me on the treatment options that would work well for me. Instead of simply recommending medication or treatments, he explained exactly why it is necessary and how it will help my issue and ofcourse why the problem exists in the first place.

I even underwent a MNRF (Micro Needling Radio Frequency) and chemical peel therapy for the acne and the acne scars. I saw almost immediate results. The staff are very cordial and make sure that you are very comfortable during the procedure.

I followed all of the doctor's directions and I am absolutely pleased with the results. My skin has improved significantly and I am more aware of the type of skin care routine that is more suitable for me.

Highly recommended!
